name: tate-liza-y7-ground
checks: C388/C389 v3.9 Y7-GROUND: Tate & Liza double battle vs four grounded Pokémon (SHELGON 41, LINOONE, WHISCASH, GOLDUCK 40; full HP, no bag, slot 1, target opponent-left). Turn 1 CLAYDOL's EARTHQUAKE fires and doesn't affect XATU; the grounded team must LOSE (guard). C388 as built (XATU PSYCHIC): LOSS 7t 4/2, faintCauses CLAYDOL/EARTHQUAKE 1, XATU/PSYCHIC 1, ESPEON/PSYCHIC 1, ESPEON/SHADOW BALL 1. C389 (XATU PSYCHIC -> NIGHT_SHADE, the one move dial): LOSS 7t 4/2 (XATU + CLAYDOL down), EQ turns 1,2,4, faintCauses CLAYDOL/EARTHQUAKE 1, XATU/SHADOW BALL 1, ESPEON/SHADOW BALL 1, LUNATONE/PSYCHIC 1. Closed C389 (branch B).

steps.comment: Boots on 23,8 (MB_NORMAL c0; `node scripts/map_scan.cjs MossdeepCity_Gym 21-25 6-10`), right below TATE (object 1, 23,7, MossdeepCity_Gym_EventScript_TateAndLiza). C389: closed, see strategy-notes v3.9 retrospective. Guard: the grounded team loses (EQ is meant to punish a grounded pair).
